error_reason: The Planner failed to recognize that the same PDF URL (bgsp.edu) had already been attempted unsuccessfully in Turn 8 and Turn 10-12. Instead of acknowledging the persistent failure to extract text from that specific source and pivoting to a different search strategy or accepting the information limitation, the Planner blindly instructed the WebSurfer to retry the exact same URL again in Turn 9 (which failed immediately) and allowed the WebSurfer to repeat the same failed action in Turn 12. This represents a failure to adapt the search strategy due to repeated negative results, causing the agent to repeat ineffective steps.

suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent should not attempt to fetch the same URL if it has previously returned a 404 error or empty content within the last 3 turns. Instead, it should immediately try alternative keywords or verify if the URL exists in a cached list of known valid sources.

probe_details.notes:
The proposed analysis incorrectly identifies the error turn range and the source of repetition. 
1. The error turns are Turn 9, 10, 11, and 13. Turn 12 and 14 are Planner turns that analyze the errors, they are not the actions being repeated. 
2. The claim that the Planner 'failed to recognize' the bgsp.edu URL (Turn 15) because it was attempted in Turn 8/10/12 is factually incorrect based on the provided trace. The URL 'bgsp.edu' appears ONLY in Turn 15. It was NOT attempted in Turn 8 (ERIC), Turn 9 (Search), Turn 10 (Search), Turn 11 (Search), or Turn 13 (UPenn 404). 
3. The actual error is that the WebSurfer/Planner loop continued to try variations of the UPenn link (Turn 9, 11, 13) after Turn 13 returned a 404, wasting 3 turns before trying the bgsp.edu link. The analysis describes a repetition of bgsp.edu which never happened prior to the current attempt.
